notes: Company profile: mid-market e-comm personalization platform; drives product descriptions, cross-sell messaging, and in-app support. High call volume periods during sales/promos; needs predictable throughput.
Current stack: webapp + analytics; embeddings used for product search/recall; chat used in support and inline product copy generation. Currently on OpenAI API; monthly token spend ~15k USD.
POC focus: drop-in parity for prompts used in product-description generator (tone = playful/concise) and support bot Q/A accuracy. Also embeddings recall stability across updates.
Migration ask: compatibility layer to minimize code changes - prefer model name mapping, response envelope parity, and rate-limit behavior mimicry. Want SDK shim plan for 2-week cutover window.
Acceptance criteria: >=90% prompt-level parity on quality metrics (human-reviewed), embeddings recall delta < 2% on top-k retrieval, median latency under 220ms for common chat calls.
Observed POC results: hosted runs show slightly lower token costs (~18% savings) and better batching economics; small cluster of prompts (8%) produced tonal shifts or increased hallucination risk.
SE recommendations: targeted prompt-engineering templates, small supervised fine-tune on 200 examples for the promotional copy cohort, or use reranking with safety filters.
Perf targets: production throughput target 200 req/s on Dedicated with autoscale; p95 latency target 650ms; expected throughput improvements once batching/caching enabled.
Security: Legal wants SOC2 Type 2 and clear KMS flow diagram before Dedicated contract. Also asked about data residency options for EU customers. Retention controls requested (30/90/365-day options).
Business drivers: finance wants modeled TCO showing Dedicated commit pays off within 9-12 months vs hosted. Product cares about tone parity; conversion rates tied to copy tone.
Quote from VP Eng: 'We can tolerate some differences during migration but product copy must stay consistent or we risk conversion regression.'

Migration path discussed: 1) finish hosted parity POC, 2) pilot Dedicated in NA region for 2 tenants, 3) run A/B for 4 weeks with traffic split and automatic rollback on quality delta, 4) full cutover and retire old vendor.
Operational needs: per-prompt cost attribution, route-level dashboards, and alerting on quality regressions. Want retention of token-level logs for 90 days.
Commercial: Aurora is price-sensitive; procurement wants tiered pricing and a clear overage/burst policy. Interested in a 12-month Dedicated commit if parity confirmed.
Open questions: timeline for KMS integration, availability of SOC2 artifacts, and whether Redwood can mirror OpenAI's response meta fields (id, usage) to simplify migration.
Next steps: deliver parity matrix + recommended remediation plan (Samira), share Dedicated sizing + financial model (Ethan), schedule procurement review mid-March
